scenario_description:
Objective: Use a newly released, no-fee tower-cab observer seat to improve radio-communication listening before the upcoming cross-country simulator prep.
Emerging Need: The opening starts as a staffing-dependent possibility with a conflicting study block and no verified RSVP route; later cancellation, contact verification, and a coded seat release make it actionable.
Decision Context: Stored training notes identify radio readbacks as the relevant optional enrichment target and prefer verified, no-fee experiences that are not claimed as logbook credit.
Consequence: Securing a seat could add concrete phraseology examples for practice; if the roster closes, normal lessons, requirements, spending, and progress continue unchanged.

parameter.subject: Possible Jan 30 tower observation release
parameter.body: Centennial Tower may be able to host two Virelli Flying Club learner observers on Friday, Jan 30, if staffing confirms. This is only a possibility for now; no roster is open and no RSVP address or code should be used until the coordinator notice is posted.

parameter.notes: Verified by VFC directory sync for student observation RSVPs.

parameter.content: Training desk just confirmed the Jan 30 tower-cab observer mini-tour, 13:40-14:45. Two learner seats are open. Use code RADIO-OBS-130 with the Tower Visit Coordinator by 16:30 today; no fee and not logbook credit.

parameter.subject: Jan 30 tower observation roster closed
parameter.body: The request deadline for the Jan 30 tower-cab observer visit closed at 16:30 as announced. Staff finalized the accepted on-time requests at 16:35; no request received after 16:30 can enter Friday's confirmed access list. Later messages are for future-visit interest only.
